Endpoint equalities checked analytically; rational verifier only supplements.

value.rationale: Sharp transition between finite-atomic, infinitely countably atomic and diffuse stationary laws for a natural fixed-step proximal solver on a strongly convex nonsmooth split objective. A finite, explicit reset word describes regenerative behavior and rare-event sensitivity; the diffuse transition is independent of step but the two-atom transition permits exact fixed-objective tuning. These qualitative distinctions are not conveyed by expected objective rate theorems and motivate stochastic numerical method diagnostics.
